overview.description: The Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF (FMUN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks an index of USD-denominated municipal bonds of any maturity with an investment-grade credit rating. The fund seeks to provide high yields exempt from federal income tax. FMUN was launched on Apr 4, 2025 and is issued by Fidelity.

data.title: Fidelity® Launches Two Fixed Income ETFs, Expanding Lineup for Investors and Advisors
data.text: BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Fidelity announced the launch of two fixed income ETFs: Fidelity Municipal Bond Opportunities ETF and Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF.
